resources.string: Choose how Candy reads articles and selected text. Download the multilingual voice model once to read aloud entirely on your device.
Download a multilingual voice model for offline reading, or use your Android voice. Your choice applies to articles and selected text. You can change it in Settings → Browser → Read aloud.
When off, Candy uses your Android voice. Turning this off keeps the downloaded model.
The voice model could not be downloaded or updated. Check your connection and free storage, then try again.
Voice model downloaded. Ready for offline reading.

Supertonic 3 · approximately 145 MB download · 31 languages including English and German. Article text stays on your device when using the offline model. Deleting the model switches back to Android voices.
By downloading or enabling the model, you agree to its OpenRAIL-M license, including its use restrictions. The voice is AI-generated.
This voice could not read the text. Try again or switch voices.
Reading aloud is unavailable. Check the voice model in Settings → Browser → Read aloud, or your Android text-to-speech settings.
